title: Breakdown of Aharonov-Bohm cage in Rydberg synthetic lattices: the roles of inhomogeneity and long-range exchange
summary: While the interaction-induced breakdown of Aharonov-Bohm (AB) cage is typically attributed to uniform bound-pair transport, systems with inhomogeneous exchange interactions realized with Rydberg synthetic lattices exhibit more complex dynamics. Employing the evolution-path symmetry (EPS) framework developed recently, we analyze the two-particle dynamics via path interference in Fock space. We find that a homogeneous nearest-neighbor exchange interaction cannot break the AB cage, regardless of whether the long-range exchange interaction is present or not.
